notes: Object insert. As grammar-insert-0003: 'Hittite attests kuwarzanalli' makes it a Hittite word through the catalogue (attested_in, the inverse of attests_word, is a subproperty of word_of_language), so the local rule attests_word -> word_of_language is gone since 2026-10-31. The script is written_in_script of the language; 'oldest attested Indo-European language' is a class. q3 ('the same branch') is a join through the branch individual (instance_of, branches as individuals beside the language classes); the 'no' needs the two one-language presuppositions as 'only' restrictions and each language's one branch as a nominal (firm). Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

queries.ask: kuwarzanalli : word_of_language some (instance_of some (IndoEuropeanBranch and inv(instance_of) some (inv(word_of_language) value bread)))

fol.notes: As grammar-insert-0003, with Indo-European branches. The one-language presuppositions are the chain's unstated assumptions.

local.branch_of: the branch of a language family a language belongs to (one branch per language)

words.says: The two words are spelled 'kuwarzanalli' and 'bread'.

attests_def.says: A word a language attests is a word of that language.
attests_def.z3: ForAll([l, w], Implies(attests_word(l, w), word_of_language(w, l)))

hittite_anatolian.says: Hittite is one of the Anatolian languages.

bread_english.says: The English word 'bread' is a word of English.

kuwarzanalli_one_language.says: 'Kuwarzanalli' is a word of one language only. (closed world)

bread_one_language.says: 'Bread' is a word of English only. (closed world)

queries.ask: Exists([l, l2], And(word_of_language(kuwarzanalli, l), word_of_language(bread, l2), branch_of(l) == branch_of(l2)))
